requirements.quote: There shall be affixed, conspicuously and in a readily accessible place specified on the approval form, to every vehicle conforming to a vehicle type approved under this Regulation
requirements.text: The vehicle shall bear an international approval mark affixed conspicuously in a readily accessible place specified on the approval form.

requirements.quote: A circle surrounding the Letter "E" followed by the distinguishing number of the country which has granted approval.
requirements.text: The approval mark shall consist of a circle surrounding the letter "E" followed by the distinguishing number of the granting country.

requirements.quote: The number of this Regulation, followed by the letter "R", a dash and the approval number to the right of the circle described in paragraph 4.1.1.
requirements.text: The approval mark shall show the number of the Regulation, followed by the letter "R", a dash and the approval number to the right of the circle.

requirements.quote: the Regulation and approval numbers and the additional symbols of all the Regulations under which approval has been granted in the country which has granted approval
requirements.text: Where the vehicle is also approved under other Regulations of the Agreement, the Regulation and approval numbers and additional symbols of all those Regulations shall be placed in vertical columns to the right of the "E" symbol.

requirements.quote: The approval mark shall be clearly legible and shall be indelible.
requirements.text: The approval mark shall be clearly legible and indelible.

requirements.quote: The approval mark shall be placed on or close to the vehicle data plate affixed by the Manufacturer.
requirements.text: The approval mark shall be placed on or close to the vehicle data plate affixed by the manufacturer.

requirements.quote: The vehicle manufacturer shall identify and manage, for the vehicle type being approved, supplier-related risks.
requirements.text: The vehicle shall be designed so that supplier-related risks for the vehicle type are identified and managed, including for the telematics unit, gateway and update host.

requirements.quote: The vehicle manufacturer shall identify the critical elements of the vehicle type and perform an exhaustive risk assessment for the vehicle type and shall treat/manage the identified risks appropriately.
requirements.text: The vehicle shall have its critical elements identified and an exhaustive risk assessment performed, with the identified risks treated and managed appropriately.

requirements.quote: The risk assessment shall consider the individual elements of the vehicle type and their interactions.
requirements.text: The vehicle's risk assessment shall consider the individual elements of the vehicle type and their interactions.

requirements.quote: The risk assessment shall further consider interactions with any external systems.
requirements.text: The vehicle's risk assessment shall consider interactions with external systems, including back-end servers and update delivery systems.

requirements.quote: While assessing the risks, the vehicle manufacturer shall consider the risks related to all the threats referred to in Annex 5, Part A, as well as any other relevant risk.
requirements.text: The vehicle's risk assessment shall consider the risks related to all threats referred to in Annex 5, Part A, as well as any other relevant risk.

requirements.quote: The vehicle manufacturer shall protect the vehicle type against risks identified in the vehicle manufacturer’s risk assessment. Proportionate mitigations shall be implemented to protect the vehicle type.
requirements.text: The vehicle shall be protected against the risks identified in the risk assessment by proportionate mitigations implemented on the vehicle type.

requirements.quote: The mitigations implemented shall include all mitigations referred to in Annex 5, Part B and C which are relevant for the risks identified.
requirements.text: The vehicle shall implement all mitigations referred to in Annex 5, Parts B and C that are relevant for the risks identified.

requirements.quote: if a mitigation referred to in Annex 5, Part B or C, is not relevant or not sufficient for the risk identified, the vehicle manufacturer shall ensure that another appropriate mitigation is implemented
requirements.text: Where a mitigation from Annex 5, Part B or C is not relevant or not sufficient for an identified risk, the vehicle shall implement another appropriate mitigation.

requirements.quote: The vehicle manufacturer shall put in place appropriate and proportionate measures to secure dedicated environments on the vehicle type (if provided) for the storage and execution of aftermarket software, services, applications or data.
requirements.text: Where dedicated environments for storage and execution of aftermarket software, services, applications or data are provided, the vehicle shall protect them with appropriate and proportionate measures.

requirements.quote: Detect and prevent cyber-attacks against vehicles of the vehicle type
requirements.text: The vehicle shall implement measures to detect and prevent cyber-attacks against it.

requirements.quote: Support the monitoring capability of the vehicle manufacturer with regards to detecting threats, vulnerabilities and cyber-attacks relevant to the vehicle type
requirements.text: The vehicle shall implement measures supporting the manufacturer's monitoring capability for detecting threats, vulnerabilities and cyber-attacks relevant to the vehicle type.

requirements.quote: Provide data forensic capability to enable analysis of attempted or successful cyber-attacks.
requirements.text: The vehicle shall provide data forensic capability enabling analysis of attempted or successful cyber-attacks.

requirements.quote: Cryptographic modules used for the purpose of this Regulation shall be in line with consensus standards.
requirements.text: Cryptographic modules used in the vehicle for cyber security purposes shall be in line with consensus standards.

requirements.quote: Tests shall be performed by the Approval Authority or the Technical Service itself or in collaboration with the vehicle manufacturer by sampling.
requirements.text: The vehicle shall be so constructed that the documented cyber security measures can be verified by testing by sampling, focused on the risks assessed as high.

requirements.paragraph: Annex 5 Part B 1. Table B1 M10
requirements.quote: The vehicle shall verify the authenticity and integrity of messages it receives
requirements.text: The vehicle shall verify the authenticity and integrity of messages it receives.

requirements.paragraph: Annex 5 Part B 1. Table B1 M11
requirements.quote: Security controls shall be implemented for storing cryptographic keys (e.g., use of Hardware Security Modules)
requirements.text: The vehicle shall implement security controls for storing cryptographic keys, such as hardware security modules.

requirements.paragraph: Annex 5 Part B 1. Table B1 M6
requirements.quote: Systems shall implement security by design to minimize risks
requirements.text: The vehicle's systems shall implement security by design to minimise risks.

requirements.paragraph: Annex 5 Part B 1. Table B1 M7
requirements.quote: Access control techniques and designs shall be applied to protect system data/code
requirements.text: The vehicle shall apply access control techniques and designs to protect system data and code.

requirements.paragraph: Annex 5 Part B 1. Table B1 M12
requirements.quote: Confidential data transmitted to or from the vehicle shall be protected
requirements.text: Confidential data transmitted to or from the vehicle shall be protected.

requirements.paragraph: Annex 5 Part B 1. Table B1 M8
requirements.quote: Through system design and access control it should not be possible for unauthorized personnel to access personal or system critical data.
requirements.text: Through system design and access control, the vehicle shall prevent unauthorised personnel from accessing personal or system-critical data.

requirements.paragraph: Annex 5 Part B 1. Table B1 M13
requirements.quote: Measures to detect and recover from a denial of service attack shall be employed
requirements.text: The vehicle shall employ measures to detect and recover from a denial of service attack.

requirements.paragraph: Annex 5 Part B 1. Table B1 M9
requirements.quote: Measures to prevent and detect unauthorized access shall be employed
requirements.text: The vehicle shall employ measures to prevent and detect unauthorised access.

requirements.paragraph: Annex 5 Part B 1. Table B1 M14
requirements.quote: Measures to protect systems against embedded viruses/malware should be considered
requirements.text: The vehicle shall consider measures protecting its systems against embedded viruses and malware.

requirements.paragraph: Annex 5 Part B 1. Table B1 M15
requirements.quote: Measures to detect malicious internal messages or activity should be considered
requirements.text: The vehicle shall consider measures to detect malicious internal messages or activity on its in-vehicle network.

requirements.paragraph: Annex 5 Part B 2. Table B2 M16
requirements.quote: Secure software update procedures shall be employed
requirements.text: The vehicle shall employ secure software update procedures, including for over-the-air updates.

requirements.paragraph: Annex 5 Part B 2. Table B2 M11
requirements.quote: Security controls shall be implemented for storing cryptographic keys
requirements.text: The vehicle shall implement security controls for storing the cryptographic keys used for software updates.

requirements.paragraph: Annex 5 Part B 2. Table B2 M3
requirements.quote: Security Controls shall be applied to back-end systems. Where back-end servers are critical to the provision of services there are recovery measures in case of system outage
requirements.text: Where back-end servers are critical to the provision of update services, security controls and recovery measures for system outage shall be applied to those systems.

requirements.paragraph: Annex 5 Part B 3. Table B3 M18
requirements.quote: Measures shall be implemented for defining and controlling user roles and access privileges, based on the principle of least access privilege
requirements.text: The vehicle shall implement measures defining and controlling user roles and access privileges on the principle of least access privilege.

requirements.paragraph: Annex 5 Part B 3. Table B3 M19
requirements.quote: including logging of actions and access related to the management of the security functions
requirements.text: The vehicle shall log actions and access related to the management of its security functions.

requirements.paragraph: Annex 5 Part B 4. Table B4 M20
requirements.quote: Security controls shall be applied to systems that have remote access
requirements.text: The vehicle shall apply security controls to systems that have remote access, including the telematics control unit.

requirements.paragraph: Annex 5 Part B 4. Table B4 M21
requirements.quote: Software shall be security assessed, authenticated and integrity protected.
requirements.text: Software hosted on the vehicle shall be security assessed, authenticated and integrity protected.

requirements.paragraph: Annex 5 Part B 4. Table B4 M21
requirements.quote: Security controls shall be applied to minimise the risk from third party software that is intended or foreseeable to be hosted on the vehicle
requirements.text: The vehicle shall apply security controls to minimise the risk from third-party software intended or foreseeable to be hosted on it.

requirements.paragraph: Annex 5 Part B 4. Table B4 M22
requirements.quote: Security controls shall be applied to external interfaces
requirements.text: The vehicle shall apply security controls to its external interfaces, including USB, OBD and diagnostic ports.

requirements.paragraph: Annex 5 Part B 6. Table B6 M23
requirements.quote: Cybersecurity best practices for software and hardware development shall be followed
requirements.text: The vehicle shall be developed following cybersecurity best practices for software and hardware development.

requirements.paragraph: Annex 5 Part B 6. Table B6 M23
requirements.quote: Cybersecurity best practices for system design and system integration shall be followed
requirements.text: The vehicle shall be designed and integrated following cybersecurity best practices for system design and system integration.

requirements.paragraph: Annex 5 Part B 7. Table B7 M24
requirements.quote: Best practices for the protection of data integrity and confidentiality shall be followed for storing personal data.
requirements.text: The vehicle shall follow best practices for the protection of data integrity and confidentiality when storing personal data.

requirements.paragraph: Annex 5 Part B 8. Table B8 M9
requirements.quote: Measures to prevent and detect unauthorized access shall be employed
requirements.text: The vehicle shall employ measures to prevent and detect unauthorised physical access and hardware manipulation.

requirements.paragraph: Annex 5 Part C 1. Table C1 M1
requirements.quote: Security Controls are applied to back-end systems to minimise the risk of insider attack
requirements.text: Security controls shall be applied to the vehicle manufacturer's back-end systems to minimise the risk of insider attack.

requirements.paragraph: Annex 5 Part C 1. Table C1 M2
requirements.quote: Security Controls are applied to back-end systems to minimise unauthorised access.
requirements.text: Security controls shall be applied to back-end systems to minimise unauthorised access affecting the vehicle.

requirements.paragraph: Annex 5 Part C 1. Table C1 M3
requirements.quote: Security Controls are applied to back-end systems. Where back-end servers are critical to the provision of services there are recovery measures in case of system outage.
requirements.text: Security controls and recovery measures for system outage shall be applied where back-end servers are critical to services relied on by the vehicle.

requirements.paragraph: Annex 5 Part C 1. Table C1 M4
requirements.quote: Security Controls are applied to minimise risks associated with cloud computing.
requirements.text: Security controls shall be applied to minimise risks associated with cloud computing used for vehicle data.

requirements.paragraph: Annex 5 Part C 1. Table C1 M5
requirements.quote: Security Controls are applied to back-end systems to prevent data breaches.
requirements.text: Security controls shall be applied to back-end systems to prevent breaches of vehicle-related data.

requirements.paragraph: Annex 5 Part C 3. Table C3 M24
requirements.quote: Best practices for the protection of data integrity and confidentiality shall be followed for storing personal data.
requirements.text: Best practices for the protection of data integrity and confidentiality shall be followed for personal data stored for or by the vehicle.

requirements.quote: There shall be affixed, conspicuously and in a readily accessible place specified on the approval form, to every vehicle conforming to a vehicle type approved under this Regulation
requirements.text: The vehicle shall bear an international approval mark for its software update approval, affixed conspicuously at a readily accessible place specified on the approval form.

requirements.quote: A circle surrounding the Letter "E" followed by the distinguishing number of the country which has granted approval.
requirements.text: The software update approval mark shall consist of a circle surrounding the letter "E" followed by the distinguishing number of the granting country.

requirements.quote: The number of this Regulation, followed by the letter "R", a dash and the approval number to the right of the circle described in paragraph 4.1.1.
requirements.text: The software update approval mark shall show the number of the Regulation, followed by the letter "R", a dash and the approval number to the right of the circle.

requirements.quote: The approval mark shall be clearly legible and shall be indelible.
requirements.text: The software update approval mark shall be clearly legible and indelible.

requirements.quote: The approval mark shall be placed on or close to the vehicle data plate affixed by the Manufacturer.
requirements.text: The software update approval mark shall be placed on or close to the vehicle data plate affixed by the manufacturer.

requirements.quote: The authenticity and integrity of software updates shall be protected to reasonably prevent their compromise and reasonably prevent invalid updates.
requirements.text: The vehicle shall protect the authenticity and integrity of software updates to reasonably prevent their compromise and invalid updates.

requirements.quote: Each RXSWIN shall be uniquely identifiable.
requirements.text: Each RXSWIN held for the vehicle shall be uniquely identifiable.

requirements.quote: Each RXSWIN shall be easily readable in a standardized way via the use of an electronic communication interface, at least by the standard interface (OBD port).
requirements.text: Each RXSWIN shall be easily readable in a standardised way via an electronic communication interface, at least through the OBD port.

requirements.quote: The vehicle manufacturer shall protect the RXSWINs and/or software version(s) on a vehicle against unauthorised modification.
requirements.text: The vehicle shall protect the RXSWINs and/or software versions held on it against unauthorised modification.

requirements.quote: The vehicle manufacturer shall ensure that the vehicle is able to restore systems to their previous version in case of a failed or interrupted update or that the vehicle can be placed into a safe state after a failed or interrupted update.
requirements.text: The vehicle shall be able to restore systems to their previous version after a failed or interrupted update, or be placed into a safe state.

requirements.quote: software updates can only be executed when the vehicle has enough power to complete the update process (including that needed for a possible recovery to the previous version or for the vehicle to be placed into a safe state)
requirements.text: The vehicle shall execute a software update only when it has enough power to complete the update, including any recovery to the previous version or placement into a safe state.

requirements.quote: When the execution of an update may affect the safety of the vehicle, the vehicle manufacturer shall demonstrate how the update will be executed safely.
requirements.text: When execution of an update may affect vehicle safety, the vehicle shall execute it safely by technical means ensuring the vehicle is in a state where the update can be executed safely.

requirements.quote: The vehicle manufacturer shall demonstrate that the vehicle user is able to be informed about an update before the update is executed.
requirements.text: The vehicle shall inform the vehicle user about an update before it is executed.

requirements.quote: The purpose of the update. This could include the criticality of the update and if the update is for recall, safety and/or security purposes
requirements.text: The pre-update information shall state the purpose of the update, including its criticality and whether it is for recall, safety or security purposes.

requirements.quote: Any changes implemented by the update on vehicle functions
requirements.text: The pre-update information shall state any changes the update implements on vehicle functions.

requirements.quote: The expected time to complete execution of the update
requirements.text: The pre-update information shall state the expected time to complete execution of the update.

requirements.quote: Any vehicle functionalities which may not be available during the execution of the update
requirements.text: The pre-update information shall state any vehicle functionalities that may be unavailable during execution of the update.

requirements.quote: Any instructions that may help the vehicle user safely execute the update
requirements.text: The pre-update information shall give any instructions that help the vehicle user safely execute the update.

requirements.quote: Ensure the vehicle cannot be driven during the execution of the update
requirements.text: Where execution of an update while driving may not be safe, the vehicle shall ensure it cannot be driven during execution of the update.

requirements.quote: Ensure that the driver is not able to use any functionality of the vehicle that would affect the safety of the vehicle or the successful execution of the update.
requirements.text: Where execution of an update while driving may not be safe, the vehicle shall prevent the driver from using any functionality that would affect safety or the successful execution of the update.

requirements.quote: The vehicle user is able to be informed of the success (or failure) of the update
requirements.text: After execution of an update, the vehicle shall inform the vehicle user of its success or failure.

requirements.quote: The vehicle user is able to be informed about the changes implemented and any related updates to the user manual (if applicable).
requirements.text: After execution of an update, the vehicle shall inform the vehicle user about the changes implemented and any related updates to the user manual.

requirements.quote: The vehicle shall ensure that preconditions have to be met before the software update is executed.
requirements.text: The vehicle shall ensure that preconditions are met before a software update is executed.

requirements.quote: A process to confirm the compatibility of a software update with the target vehicle(s) configuration before it is issued.
requirements.text: The vehicle shall be configured so that compatibility of a software update with the target vehicle configuration is confirmed before the update is issued.

requirements.quote: A process whereby the vehicle user is able to be informed about updates
requirements.text: The vehicle shall support informing the vehicle user about updates.

requirements.quote: unique identification for the type approved system’s hardware and software (including software versions) and any relevant vehicle or system parameters
requirements.text: The vehicle shall provide unique identification of the hardware and software, including software versions, of its type-approved systems and relevant vehicle or system parameters.

requirements.quote: The process they will use to ensure that software updates will be protected to reasonably prevent manipulation before the update process is initiated
requirements.text: The vehicle shall protect software updates to reasonably prevent their manipulation before the update process is initiated.

requirements.quote: The update processes used are protected to reasonably prevent them being compromised, including development of the update delivery system
requirements.text: The vehicle's update processes, including the update delivery system, shall be protected to reasonably prevent them being compromised.

requirements.quote: The vehicle manufacturer shall demonstrate the processes and procedures they will use to assess that over the air updates will not impact safety, if conducted during driving.
requirements.text: The vehicle shall assess that over-the-air updates conducted during driving will not impact safety.

requirements.quote: when an over the air update requires a specific skilled or complex action, for example recalibrate a sensor post-programming, in order to complete the update process, the update can only proceed when a person skilled to do that action is present or is in control of the process
requirements.text: Where an over-the-air update requires a specific skilled or complex action to complete, the vehicle shall allow the update to proceed only when a person skilled to perform that action is present or in control of the process.

requirements.quote: the software version(s) shall be easily readable in a standardized way via the use of an electronic communication interface, at least by the standard interface (OBD port).
requirements.text: Where RXSWINs are not held on the vehicle, the software version(s) shall be easily readable in a standardised way at least via the OBD port.

requirements.quote: An approval mark described in paragraph 5.3. below shall be affixed to every vehicle conforming to a type approved under this Regulation.
requirements.text: The vehicle shall bear the EMC approval mark described in paragraph 5.3.

requirements.quote: An international approval mark shall be affixed, in a conspicuous and easily accessible place specified on the approval communication form, on each vehicle conforming to the type approved under this Regulation.
requirements.text: The EMC approval mark shall be affixed in a conspicuous and easily accessible place specified on the approval communication form.

requirements.quote: A circle containing the letter "E", followed by the distinguishing number of the country granting the approval.
requirements.text: The EMC approval mark shall comprise a circle containing the letter "E", followed by the distinguishing number of the country granting the approval.

requirements.quote: The number of this Regulation, followed by the letter "R", a dash and the approval number to the right of the circle specified in paragraph 5.3.1. above.
requirements.text: The EMC approval mark shall show the number of this Regulation, followed by the letter "R", a dash and the approval number to the right of the circle.

requirements.quote: A vehicle and its electrical/electronic system(s) or ESA(s) shall be designed, constructed and fitted in such a way as to enable the vehicle, in normal conditions of use, to comply with the requirements of this Regulation.
requirements.text: The vehicle and its electrical/electronic systems shall be designed, constructed and fitted so that, in normal conditions of use, the vehicle complies with the EMC requirements of this Regulation.

requirements.quote: A vehicle shall be tested for radiated emissions and for immunity to radiated disturbances.
requirements.text: The vehicle shall be so built that it can be tested for radiated emissions and for immunity to radiated disturbances.

requirements.quote: On the vehicle representative of its type, the measured values, expressed in dB microvolts/m shall be below the type approval limits.
requirements.text: The vehicle's broadband radiated emissions, expressed in dB microvolts/m, shall be below the type approval limits.

requirements.quote: the limits shall be 32 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band and 32 to 43 dB microvolts/m in the 75 to 400 MHz frequency band
requirements.text: For measurements at a vehicle-to-antenna spacing of 10.0 ± 0.2 m, the vehicle's broadband emissions shall be at most 32 dB microvolts/m from 30 to 75 MHz and 32 to 43 dB microvolts/m from 75 to 400 MHz.

requirements.quote: In the 400 to 1,000 MHz frequency band the limit remains constant at 43 dB microvolts/m.
requirements.text: For measurements at 10.0 ± 0.2 m, the vehicle's broadband emissions from 400 to 1,000 MHz shall not exceed 43 dB microvolts/m.

requirements.quote: the limits shall be 42 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band and 42 to 53 dB microvolts/m in the 75 to 400 MHz frequency band
requirements.text: For measurements at a vehicle-to-antenna spacing of 3.0 ± 0.05 m, the vehicle's broadband emissions shall be at most 42 dB microvolts/m from 30 to 75 MHz and 42 to 53 dB microvolts/m from 75 to 400 MHz.

requirements.quote: the limits shall be 28 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 230 MHz frequency band and 35 dB microvolts/m in the 230 to 1,000 MHz frequency band
requirements.text: For measurements at a vehicle-to-antenna spacing of 10.0 ± 0.2 m, the vehicle's narrowband emissions shall be at most 28 dB microvolts/m from 30 to 230 MHz and 35 dB microvolts/m from 230 to 1,000 MHz.

requirements.quote: the limits shall be 38 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 230 MHz frequency band and 45 dB microvolts/m in the 230 to 1,000 MHz frequency band
requirements.text: For measurements at a vehicle-to-antenna spacing of 3.0 ± 0.05 m, the vehicle's narrowband emissions shall be at most 38 dB microvolts/m from 30 to 230 MHz and 45 dB microvolts/m from 230 to 1,000 MHz.

requirements.quote: On the vehicle representative of its type, the measured values, expressed in dB microvolts/m, shall be below the type approval limit.
requirements.text: The vehicle's narrowband radiated emissions, expressed in dB microvolts/m, shall be below the type approval limits.

requirements.quote: the field strength shall be 30 volts/m in over 90 per cent of the 20 to 2,000 MHz frequency band and a minimum of 25 volts/m over the whole 20 to 2,000 MHz frequency band
requirements.text: The vehicle shall be immune to a field strength of 30 V/m over at least 90 per cent of the 20 to 2,000 MHz band and at least 25 V/m over the whole band.

requirements.quote: The field strength shall be 10 volts/m in over 90 per cent of the 2,000 to 6,000 MHz frequency band and a minimum of 8 volts/m over the whole 2,000 to 6,000 MHz frequency band.
requirements.text: The vehicle shall be immune to a field strength of 10 V/m over at least 90 per cent of the 2,000 to 6,000 MHz band and at least 8 V/m over the whole band.

requirements.quote: the current shall be 60 mA in over 90 per cent of the 20 to 2,000 MHz frequency band and a minimum of 50 mA over the whole 20 to 2,000 MHz frequency band
requirements.text: Under BCI testing, the vehicle shall be immune to 60 mA over at least 90 per cent of the 20 to 2,000 MHz band and at least 50 mA over the whole band.

requirements.quote: there shall be no degradation of performance of "immunity related functions", according to paragraph 2.1. of Annex 6.
requirements.text: During immunity testing the vehicle shall show no degradation of performance of its immunity related functions, including data-bus functionality and functions affecting the driver and other road users.

requirements.quote: the limits shall be 62 to 52 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band, this limit decreasing logarithmically with frequencies above 30 MHz
requirements.text: For ESAs of the vehicle measured under Annex 7, broadband emissions shall be 62 to 52 dB microvolts/m from 30 to 75 MHz, decreasing logarithmically with frequency.

requirements.quote: 52 to 63 dB microvolts/m in the 75 to 400 MHz band, this limit increasing logarithmically with frequencies above 75 MHz as shown in Appendix 6
requirements.text: For ESAs, broadband emissions from 75 to 400 MHz shall be 52 to 63 dB microvolts/m, increasing logarithmically with frequency.

requirements.quote: In the 400 to 1,000 MHz frequency band the limit remains constant at 63 dB microvolts/m.
requirements.text: For ESAs, broadband emissions from 400 to 1,000 MHz shall not exceed 63 dB microvolts/m.

requirements.quote: the limits shall be 52 to 42 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band, this limit decreasing logarithmically with frequencies above 30 MHz
requirements.text: For ESAs measured under Annex 8, narrowband emissions shall be 52 to 42 dB microvolts/m from 30 to 75 MHz, decreasing logarithmically with frequency.

requirements.quote: 42 to 53 dB microvolts/m in the 75 to 400 MHz band, this limit increasing logarithmically with frequencies above 75 MHz as shown in Appendix 7.
requirements.text: For ESAs, narrowband emissions from 75 to 400 MHz shall be 42 to 53 dB microvolts/m, increasing logarithmically with frequency.

requirements.quote: On the ESA representative of its type, the measured value, expressed in dB microvolts/m shall be below the type approval limits.
requirements.text: The narrowband radiated emissions of the ESAs, expressed in dB microvolts/m, shall be below the type approval limits.

requirements.quote: The emission of ESA representative of its type shall be tested by the method(s) according to ISO 7637-2 as described in Annex 10 for the levels given in Table 1.
requirements.text: For a 12 V system, transient conducted emissions of ESAs on the supply lines shall not exceed +75 V for positive pulses and -100 V for negative pulses.

requirements.quote: Test severity in over 90 per cent of the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency band are given in Table 2a.
requirements.text: For ESAs below 2 GHz, immunity shall be demonstrated at 60 V/m (stripline), 75 V/m (TEM cell), 60 mA (BCI), 30 V/m (ALSE) or 21 V/m (reverberation chamber).

requirements.quote: Test level above 2 GHz
requirements.text: For ESAs above 2 GHz, immunity shall be demonstrated at 10 V/m in an ALSE or 7 V/m in a reverberation chamber over the 2,000 to 6,000 MHz band.

requirements.quote: during the tests performed in accordance with Annex 9, there shall be no degradation of performance of "immunity related functions"
requirements.text: During ESA immunity tests under Annex 9, the ESAs shall show no degradation of performance of immunity related functions.

requirements.quote: Immunity test level
requirements.text: For a 12 V system, immunity of ESAs related to immunity related functions shall meet test pulse levels of -75 V (pulse 1, 500 pulses), +37 V (pulse 2a, 500 pulses), +10 V (pulse 2b, 10 pulses), -112 V (pulse 3a, 1 h) and +75 V (pulse 3b, 1 h).

requirements.quote: Starting profile shall be tested according to the functional status classification as defined in ISO 16750-1.
requirements.text: ESAs operational during engine start shall be tested for the starting profile at level II for 10 pulses and classified to functional status C.

requirements.quote: Where a vehicle or electrical/electronic system or ESA does not include an electronic oscillator with an operating frequency greater than 9 kHz, it shall be deemed to comply with paragraph 6.3.2. or 6.6.2.
requirements.text: Where the vehicle or an ESA contains no electronic oscillator operating above 9 kHz, it shall be deemed to comply with the narrowband emission requirements.

requirements.quote: Vehicles which do not have electrical/electronic systems with "immunity related functions" need not be tested for immunity to radiated disturbances
requirements.text: Vehicles without electrical/electronic systems having immunity related functions need not be tested for immunity to radiated disturbances.

requirements.quote: RF transmitters shall be tested in the transmit mode.
requirements.text: The vehicle's RF transmitters, including the telematics unit, shall be tested in the transmit mode.

requirements.quote: Spurious emissions are subject to this Regulation.
requirements.text: Spurious emissions of the vehicle's RF transmitters shall comply with this Regulation.

requirements.quote: the vehicle manufacturer shall provide a statement of frequency bands, power levels, antenna positions and installation provisions for the installation of radio frequency transmitters (RF-transmitters)
requirements.text: The vehicle shall be documented with a statement of frequency bands, power levels, antenna positions and installation provisions for radio frequency transmitters.

requirements.quote: Vehicle manufacturers shall provide evidence that vehicle performance is not adversely affected by such transmitter installations.
requirements.text: The vehicle shall be shown not to have its performance adversely affected by the installed radio frequency transmitters.

requirements.quote: Before testing, the Technical Service shall prepare a test plan in conjunction with the manufacturer, which contains at least mode of operation, stimulated function(s), monitored function(s), pass/fail criterion(criteria) and intended emissions.
requirements.text: The vehicle shall be capable of being tested under a test plan defining its mode of operation, stimulated and monitored functions, pass/fail criteria and intended emissions.

requirements.quote: The limits given in paragraphs 6.2. and 7.2. of this Regulation are for quasi-peak detectors.
requirements.text: Where peak detectors are used for broadband emission measurement, a correction factor of 20 dB as defined in CISPR 12 shall be applied to the vehicle's readings.

requirements.quote: The Technical Service shall perform the test at the intervals specified in the CISPR 12 standard throughout the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz.
requirements.text: The vehicle's broadband emissions shall be measured at the CISPR 12 intervals over the whole 30 to 1,000 MHz frequency range.

requirements.quote: Measurements shall be made on the left and right sides of the vehicle.
requirements.text: The vehicle shall be measured on both its left and right sides for broadband emissions.

requirements.quote: The same positions shall be used for both horizontal and vertical polarization measurements.
requirements.text: The same antenna positions shall be used for the vehicle's horizontal and vertical polarisation measurements.

requirements.quote: The vehicle's electronic systems shall all be in normal operating mode with the vehicle stationary.
requirements.text: For narrowband emission measurement, all of the vehicle's electronic systems shall be in normal operating mode with the vehicle stationary.

requirements.quote: Measurements shall be performed with an average detector.
requirements.text: The vehicle's narrowband emissions shall be measured with an average detector.

requirements.quote: In the event that the limit is exceeded during the test, investigations shall be made to ensure that this is due to the vehicle and not to background radiation
requirements.text: Where a narrowband emission limit is exceeded, the vehicle shall be investigated to confirm the exceedance is due to the vehicle and not to background radiation.

requirements.quote: The engine shall normally turn the driving wheels at a steady speed of 50 km/h if there is no technical reason due to the vehicle to define a different condition.
requirements.text: For immunity testing in the 50 km/h mode, the vehicle shall drive its wheels at a steady speed of 50 km/h with speed variation not exceeding ±10 per cent.

requirements.quote: Dipped beams ON (manual mode)
requirements.text: During the 50 km/h immunity test, the vehicle's dipped beams shall be ON in manual mode and shall not switch off.

requirements.quote: Front wiper ON (manual mode) maximum speed
requirements.text: During the 50 km/h immunity test, the front wiper shall run at maximum speed and shall not come to a complete stop.

requirements.quote: Cluster operate in normal mode
requirements.text: During the 50 km/h immunity test, the instrument cluster shall operate in normal mode without unexpected warnings or inconsistent odometer variation.

requirements.quote: Airbag and safety restraint systems operational with inhibited passenger airbag if this function exists
requirements.text: During the 50 km/h immunity test, the airbag and safety restraint systems shall remain operational without unexpected activation.

requirements.quote: Direction indicator on driver's side ON
requirements.text: During the 50 km/h immunity test, the driver's side direction indicator shall flash within 0.75 to 2.25 Hz and a duty cycle of 25 to 75 per cent.

requirements.quote: The vehicle shall be exposed to electromagnetic radiation in the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency ranges in vertical polarization.
requirements.text: The vehicle shall be immune when exposed to electromagnetic radiation over 20 to 6,000 MHz in vertical polarisation.

requirements.quote: AM (amplitude modulation), with 1 kHz modulation and 80 per cent modulation depth in the 20 to 400 MHz frequency range
requirements.text: The vehicle's immunity test signal shall be amplitude modulated with 1 kHz and 80 per cent modulation depth from 20 to 400 MHz.

requirements.quote: PM3 (pulse modulation type 3), Ton 500 µs, period 1,000 µs in the 380 to 2,700 MHz and the 3,100 to 6,000 MHz frequency ranges.
requirements.text: The vehicle's immunity test signal shall be pulse modulated type 3 with 500 µs on-time and 1,000 µs period from 380 to 2,700 MHz and 3,100 to 6,000 MHz.

requirements.quote: Only non-perturbing equipment shall be used while monitoring the vehicle.
requirements.text: Only non-perturbing equipment shall be used to monitor the vehicle during its immunity tests.

requirements.quote: If the vehicle is equipped with an AECS according to UN Regulation No. 144, it shall be tested over the air for the transmission of Minimum Set of Data (MSD) and voice call
requirements.text: Where the vehicle is equipped with an accident emergency call system, it shall be tested over the air for transmission of the Minimum Set of Data and voice call before and after the immunity test.

requirements.quote: the extraneous noise or signal shall be at least 6 dB below the limits of interference given in paragraph 6.6.2.1.
requirements.text: For narrowband ESA emission measurement, the ambient extraneous noise shall be at least 6 dB below the limits of paragraph 6.6.2.1.

requirements.quote: ESAs may comply with the requirements of any combination of the following test methods at the manufacturer's discretion
requirements.text: The vehicle's ESAs shall comply with the immunity requirements through any combination of the absorber chamber, TEM cell, BCI, stripline or reverberation chamber test methods covering the full frequency range.

requirements.quote: The "substitution method" shall be used to establish the test field conditions according to ISO 11452-2.
requirements.text: For absorber chamber ESA testing, the substitution method shall be used to establish the test field conditions according to ISO 11452-2.

requirements.quote: BCI test method with substitution method and injection probe positioned at 150 mm distance to the ESA
requirements.text: For BCI ESA testing, an injection probe positioned 150 mm from the ESA shall be used with the substitution method.

requirements.quote: Measurements shall be performed with an average detector.
requirements.text: The ESAs' narrowband emissions shall be measured with an average detector.

requirements.quote: The limits apply throughout the frequency range 0.15 to 30 MHz for measurements performed in a shielded enclosure
requirements.text: The vehicle's radiofrequency conducted disturbances on charging power lines shall meet the limits over the 0.15 to 30 MHz frequency range.

requirements.quote: The Technical Service shall perform the test as specified in paragraph 7.8.2.1. of this Regulation.
requirements.text: The vehicle shall withstand electrical fast transient/burst disturbances conducted along AC and DC power lines at the levels of paragraph 7.8.2.1.

requirements.quote: the immunity test levels, for AC or DC power lines, shall be: ±2 kV test voltage in open circuit, with a rise time (Tr) of 5 ns
requirements.text: In charging mode, the vehicle shall be immune to electrical fast transients of ±2 kV in open circuit with a rise time of 5 ns, hold time 50 ns and repetition rate 5 kHz for at least 1 minute.
